name: fernandina-de-jagua-web

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,functions
scripts.deploy: npm run install:functions && npm run build && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run install:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d

description: Sitio web de Fernandina de Jagua Chocolates (San Miguel, Lima) — React + Vite, desplegado en Firebase Hosting.
